name: Last of Oktoberfest at Woodside Inn
description:
Bengaluru's Indiranagar is celebrating Oktoberfest with a special offer. The Indiranagar outlet pours ***Hell Meister*** by Geist, ***Kaiser Kölsch*** by Red Rhino, ***Dubbel Trouble*** which is a Belgian Dubbel by Flying Fox, ***Forward March-Zen*** by Toit, and ***Golden Fox***, a Hefeweizen by Flying Fox.

The line-up leans into Munich’s beer hall traditions from the first bite, opening with fun takes on Oktoberfest’s favourite snack – Pretzels. With the option for ***Cream and Onion Spiced and Korean BBQ Spiced, these pretzel knots are the perfect bites for beer*** . The small plates like **Crusty Potatoes with Crispy Onions and Creamy Obatzda, Beer Battered Gherkin Fritters** with **Honey Mustard Sour Cream** lean into classic Bavarian flavours reimagined for the modern table and Bengaluru's ***Black Forest Tart,*** drawing directly from the Schwarzwald region's most famous export.

name: INTRO TO  SEWING  CLOTHES: Make a Flow Top!
description:
What does an embodied making of clothes look like? How might such a making of clothes in collective spirit honour joyful learning? Where might this making lead us?

In this session, we will together explore how you can make a top that you can wear as you like. Away from standard measurement templates, we will instead think with the body and unpack what (fun)ctionality in clothes can feel like and offer.

As we engage in this session, you will also learn the basics of pattern making, seam work, and garment construction, all while making the process yours and only yours.

Beginners are welcome.

All material will be provided.

name: Self Defense Workshop for Women
description:
**How long are we going to keep blaming women for the violence men choose to inflict on them?**

Don't go out late. Don't wear that. Don't go alone. Be careful. Be alert. Protect yourself.

How much of our lives are we expected to shrink just to feel safe?

For this workshop, I've kept the price as low as possible, with absolutely no intention of making a profit. Because this isn't just another fun activity. It's a skill every woman deserves the chance to learn.

I'm tired of victim blaming. I'm tired of women being told to change their lives because some men refuse to change their behaviour.

And while learning self-defence shouldn't be a woman's responsibility, having the ability to protect yourself can make a difference.

So let's learn. Let's practise. Let's build confidence. Let's look out for each other.

It's time we stopped living in fear and started feeling empowered to protect ourselves.

Come learn to defend yourself. Because your safety matters. Always.

name: Customise Your Closet
description:
**Your clothes don't have to stay the way you bought them!**

Join us for a creative, hands-on clothing customisation workshop where you get to transform a clothing item you already own into something completely you.

And no- this isn't just a denim painting workshop!

Bring along a denim jacket, jeans, tote bag, T-shirt, shirt, shoes or pretty much any fabric item you'd love to give a makeover to. You'll have a whole range of materials to experiment with- from painting and fabric art to glitter, sequins, jewels and ribbons.

Q: What can you do?

- Paint your own designs
- Add glitter and sparkle
- Embellish with sequins & jewels
- Play around with ribbons and other details
- Mix different techniques to create something completely unique

No prior artistic skills needed! You don't have to be “good at art”, we'll have plenty of materials and inspiration for you to experiment, personalise and have fun with.

All you need to bring is the clothing/fabric item you want to customise and your imagination!

Whether you want to make something subtle and cute or go completely maximalist, this is your chance to turn something sitting in your closet into something you'd actually be excited to wear.

name: Gatecrash presents CKRAFT and ManeatingOrchid
description:
**About CKRAFT:**

CKRAFT blends the crushing force of **Metal** with the eccentric freedom of **Jazz**. Led by accordionist Charles Kieny, the quintet sets a Meshuggah inspired power trio (guitar, bass, drums) against the frantic breath of a tenor saxophone and a cyborg-accordion augmented with electronic sensors.

Medieval polyphonies, and other thousand years old melodies — roots of Western music — collide with modern creativity, opening a space for enriching cross-cultural dialogue with the Indian audience.

**LINE-UP**

Charles Kieny (augmented accordion)

Théo Nguyen Duc Long (saxophone)

Antoine Morisot (guitar)

Marc Karapetian (bass)

William Bur (drums)

**About ManeatingOrchid:**

Formed in 2011, ManeatingOrchid has spent over a decade shaping a sound that fuses prog metal, mathcore, and extreme music into something chaotic and unpredictable. Known for dense riffing, abrasive vocals, and constantly shifting song structures, the band has become one of the subcontinent’s most uncompromising heavy acts.Their self-titled 2016 EP earned cult acclaim within the underground, while Miasma (2019) and Hive Mind (2022) pushed their sound further into dissonant, volatile territory — cementing Maneating Orchid as a band that consistently defies convention.

**The Humming Tree:**

The Humming Tree - A grassroots performance venue in Bangalore, running from 2013 to 2019 and in the process becoming a cornerstone of Bangalore’s independent music, art, and cultural ecosystem.

Now, in 2026, The Humming Tree is back in a brand-new, purpose-designed space in Indiranagar. Built across 12,000 sq. ft., the venue features a 600+ capacity performance space, world-class sound and lighting systems, and a diverse F&B proposition. More than just a venue, it’s a hub for creativity, culture and collaboration.

name: Dungeons and Dragons - Learn through Play!
description:
What if Bengaluru gets too hot to play outside? What happens when a city runs out of water? And why does fixing one problem sometimes create three new ones?

Through worldbuilding and futures thinking games, you will explore sustainability challenges specific to Bengaluru and imagine the futures you'd want to live in.

Along the way, you’ll practise observation, systems thinking, creative problem-solving and collaboration, learning to connect the dots and question the world around you.

⚠️⚠️⚠️

WARNING: Do not send this to your friends, if you don't want them asking 100 questions per second.

We are not responsible for the dinner table debates that follow. 😈

Workshop Facilitator: Shubh R Wadhwa, Founder and Editor of Befizuli Sawaal Magazine

I’m a creative educator. That’s code for, I use visual design to tell stories, make ideas easier to understand, and hopefully spark a little curiosity along the way. Over the years, I’ve had the opportunity to exhibit my work at the Lalit Kala Akademi, spend a brief minute teaching at Tapmi, Manipal, NID (National Institute of Design), and work alongside farming communities to help bring their stories to urban audiences. I tend to think of design not just as something that looks aesthetic, but also as a tool for social impact. Befizuli sawaal is an extension of that belief.

What's BEFIZULI SAWAAL MAG?

A visually appetizing magazine, that pushes you down rabbit holes about how the world works

name: Dakshin Diaries by The Counterpoint Crew
description:
Dakshin Diaries by The Counterpoint Crew brings a fresh, contemporary choral experience to the proscenium stage. Featuring 20 voices delivering live amplified stage harmony, this concert explores distinct musical worlds without creative boundaries.

The performance showcases a brand-new repertoire spanning classical polyphony, soulful regional folk, and iconic melodies reimagined across Kannada, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, Telugu, and English. Audiences will experience rich vocal arrangements alongside independent music. Every piece is thoughtfully arranged to celebrate the expressive versatility and dynamic resonance of the human voice.

Designed as an immersive, seated auditorium showcase, the evening offers music lovers a rare opportunity to hear diverse genres unified through rich, multi-part choral textures. Whether you are a dedicated choral enthusiast, an indie music follower, or simply seeking an evocative musical evening, take your seat and let the harmony surround you.

name: DIY Camera Obscura
description:
Build & Experiment with a Handmade Pinhole Camera

Long before lenses and megapixels, there was the *camera obscura*—a simple box, a pinhole, and the magic of light painting an image. In this workshop with artist **Stuti Bansal**, you’ll make your own camera obscura from scratch, explore the principles of analogue image-making, and develop unique photographs using light-sensitive paper.

**You’ll get to:**

- Build your own **working camera obscura**
- Learn the science & history behind the camera obscura
- Experiment with capturing and developing images
- Take home your handmade camera + prints you create

**Who is it for?**

Artists, photographers, makers, students, and anyone curious about analog photography and light-based art. No prior experience required.
